Name: Day Spa New Jersey

Type: non-Asian

Location: Rt. 27 in Somerset, NJ

House fee: $80

Sometimes you get what you pay for, and Day Spa New Jersey (DSNJ) is no exception. It may be the most expensive spa outside of Manhattan and the reasons are quite clear. The women here are generally white and light-skinned Latina (white-Hispanic, for lack of a better term), the setting is very "spa like" and the rooms are well done. This reminds me of a place that was originally a spa for women that was transformed into something different.

What is also very different about DSNJ is the location. While almost all AMPs are walk-in from the street, DSNJ is in a medical office building. Now, I've always gone back and forth on this point, because it does provide some legitimacy to the place. However, if walking into an empty office building to a spa at 8pm is something you don't want to do, then DSNJ isn't for you. There's a reason why 8pm is the last appointment here unlike Manhattan KMPs that are open until 3am.

There are also other things about DSNJ that mongers will like. The women here are very independent from the spa management, unlike some KMPs and AMPs. What do I mean by this? These are women that could have, maybe five years ago, worked at a strip club or did mid-quality porn and then eventually got into the trade. Some are actually getting their degrees. So, this isn't a place you have to worry about the potential "ickyness" of the trade, if you know what I mean.

The prices, therefore, are going to be higher at DSNJ than most other places, including Manhattan. The house fee for a regular hour session is $80. While there is a 45 minute option for $65, I don't know what that indicates in terms of level of service. Tips are also relatively high, starting with basic service at $120 and packages up to $200 (for a total of $280 for the hour). What is included? Like most spas, there is a stand-up shower between two rooms that is used by both patrons and providers. It's your basic shower, but from experience it's DIY unless there are other arrangements made (maybe a larger tip?). Rooms are well decorated and music is pumped into the rooms, likely a light electronic mix or jazz. You'll get an actual massage from your provider, not a rubdown like most places. The girls may actually be licensed (you can see the licenses behind the desk), but that may be a plus for you. After the massage, well, whatever happens between consenting adults is private.

I will say that for the price, DSNJ has never been very consistent in level of service. I have my favorite there and she is wonderful (haven't seen her in over a year and I really regret it), engaging and an excellent provider. I've had regular sessions that have gone over an hour and, while her assets are definitely in her chest and not in the noggin, she's really great to spend some quality time with. Other women are more rush jobs which is a general criticism of other massage places. Also, I've been bait and switched there expecting one provider and getting another - generally the one that other mongers didn't want. So it's important to make an appointment far in advance. Since the girls are identified on the spa's page (just google it), you can see them in advance. Usually, there will be three girls that work in the morning and three in the afternoon, so you may have to ask who is working that day/night.

I also have it on very good source that the owner of DSNJ is connected with the local government. I have never substantiated this fact, but the spa's owner isn't very careful in revealing her identity.

DSNJ is really for men looking for a quality experience and don't mind paying a premium for service. For those that aren't attracted to Asian women or want to have an experience in a more professional atmosphere, the DSNJ is for you. I cannot guarantee that you won't feel some remorse after your visit. There are times where I've been shorted on sessions and, given my propensity to tip in advance, there's no real recourse afterward.
